sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण लक्ष्मणो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।दिधक्षन्निव तां सेनां रुषित: पावको यथा ॥ २.९६.१६॥
transliteration: evamuktastu rāmeṇa lakṣmaṇo vākyamabravīt ।didhakṣanniva tāṁ senāṁ ruṣita: pāvako yathā ॥ 2.96.16॥

translations.english: Hearing the words of Rama, enraged Lakshmana, like a flaming fire as if he would reduce the army to ashes, replied:
